name: noble
description: Noble Detailing — website monorepo (Angular web + Node.js api)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix api install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,yellow "npm --prefix web start" "npm --prefix api run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix api run build
scripts.build:prod: npm --prefix web run build:prod && npm --prefix api run build
